name: gate-g9
note: A gate row of renderer/shell/gate_d02.py: the steps before the repeat block set the views; the block runs for warm-up plus window seconds as quiet steps (d02_run.expand_repeat), and tools/perf/d02/gate_row.py times the last window seconds. No step follows the block, so the window holds only the row's views. B19 G9: G1's script with Local shown, the second view's cost. Cap 2 is named because its twelve menu items are admissible at deep-2 and wj-ia-end (the samples' cap-2 release checks); K, the router's item 2, commits and sweeps over jumble.sweep's time, and repeats cycle through the twist's powers. A refused press sweeps nothing, which gate_d02 reports as an invalid run.
